### addsource
umask 077
A='@INST@/bin/abroad'; S='@STG@'
for p in "$A" '@INST@/bin' '@INST@'; do [ -e "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ] && [ "$(/usr/bin/stat -f %u "$p")" = 0 ] && [ $(( 0$(/usr/bin/stat -f %Lp "$p") & 022 )) = 0 ] || { echo 'RESULT=31'; exit 0; }; done; [ -f "$A" ] || { echo 'RESULT=31'; exit 0; }
/bin/rm -rf "$S" && /bin/mkdir -m 700 "$S" && /usr/sbin/chown root:wheel "$S" && /bin/cp '@IN@' '@STG@/in1' && [ "$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 '@STG@/in1' | /usr/bin/cut -c1-64)" = 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa' ] || { /bin/rm -rf "$S"; echo 'RESULT=32'; exit 0; }
"$A" --yes --json 'main' 'add-source' '--url-file' '@STG@/in1' '--name' '订阅'; rc=$?; [ $rc = 0 ] || { /bin/rm -rf "$S"; echo "RESULT=$rc"; exit 0; }
/bin/rm -rf "$S"; echo 'RESULT=0'; exit 0
### restore-kill
umask 077
A='@INST@/bin/abroad'; S='@STG@'
for p in "$A" '@INST@/bin' '@INST@'; do [ -e "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ] && [ "$(/usr/bin/stat -f %u "$p")" = 0 ] && [ $(( 0$(/usr/bin/stat -f %Lp "$p") & 022 )) = 0 ] || { echo 'RESULT=31'; exit 0; }; done; [ -f "$A" ] || { echo 'RESULT=31'; exit 0; }
"$A" --yes --json 'restore' '--kill-browsers'; rc=$?; [ $rc = 0 ] || { /bin/rm -rf "$S"; echo "RESULT=$rc"; exit 0; }
/bin/rm -rf "$S"; echo 'RESULT=0'; exit 0
### mainuse-apply
umask 077
A='@INST@/bin/abroad'; S='@STG@'
for p in "$A" '@INST@/bin' '@INST@'; do [ -e "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ] && [ "$(/usr/bin/stat -f %u "$p")" = 0 ] && [ $(( 0$(/usr/bin/stat -f %Lp "$p") & 022 )) = 0 ] || { echo 'RESULT=31'; exit 0; }; done; [ -f "$A" ] || { echo 'RESULT=31'; exit 0; }
"$A" --yes --json 'main' 'use' 'n1' '--via' 'n2'; rc=$?; [ $rc = 0 ] || { /bin/rm -rf "$S"; echo "RESULT=$rc"; exit 0; }
"$A" --yes --json 'main' 'apply'; rc=$?; [ $rc = 0 ] || { /bin/rm -rf "$S"; echo "RESULT=$rc"; exit 0; }
/bin/rm -rf "$S"; echo 'RESULT=0'; exit 0

### restore-kill-cp-off
umask 077
A='@INST@/bin/abroad'; S='@STG@'
for p in "$A" '@INST@/bin' '@INST@'; do [ -e "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ] && [ "$(/usr/bin/stat -f %u "$p")" = 0 ] && [ $(( 0$(/usr/bin/stat -f %Lp "$p") & 022 )) = 0 ] || { echo 'RESULT=31'; exit 0; }; done; [ -f "$A" ] || { echo 'RESULT=31'; exit 0; }
